reason: one change made and verified; returning to the gate for the next lap in the same session (lap 1 of at most 3 before handoff)
did: The collector read two fields per window (utilization, resets_at) and discarded the rest of the usage response, so nobody knew whether a finer signal was already being sent. scripts/usage-fields.mjs now records the unread fields — numbers only, key names filtered against the same pattern verify-sanitized-state.mjs enforces, bounded in count and length — and read-claude-usage.mjs writes it as field_probe, wrapped in a catch so an unexpected response shape cannot stop quota data being written.

observed_not_guessed.resolution_wall_confirmed_again: this lap opened at 43% and closed at 43%: below_measurement_resolution, the tenth consecutive unusable sample. Weekly percent is an integer, not 0.1-rounded as an older comment claimed.
observed_not_guessed.five_hour_is_finer_but_only_5x: over 06:01:44Z..08:37:32Z the weekly figure moved 44 -> 43 while five_hour moved 99 -> 94. Read from the git history of state/claude-usage.json, which is an hourly-or-better record nobody was using as a measurement source.
observed_not_guessed.probe_answered_it: dispatched claude-usage-monitor at 08:45Z; the 08:48:26.868Z collection on origin/main carries field_probe. Every window exposes limit_dollars, used_dollars and remaining_dollars, and the payload carries limits, spend, and four unmapped windows (seven_day_oauth_apps, seven_day_cowork, seven_day_omelette and a set of codenamed buckets).
observed_not_guessed.dollars_are_not_numbers_yet: used_dollars landed in other_field_names, not numeric_fields, so the API sends it as something other than a finite JSON number. The type is the next thing to establish; the probe deliberately does not copy string values.
observed_not_guessed.mutation_tested: removing the key-name filter from safeName makes tests/run-tests.mjs fail on "field probe copied a forbidden key out of the API response"; restored, the suite passes.

next_lap_should: Capture used_dollars. The probe proves the field exists on every window; it is not a finite number, so the safe next step is to accept decimal-looking strings (/^-?\d+(\.\d+)?$/) as numbers in usage-fields.mjs, or map used_dollars into quota_windows directly. A decimal string cannot be a credential, so this stays inside the numbers-only rule. If used_dollars carries cents or better, lap cost becomes measurable on the first try and pacing stops reserving 0.5% x 133 runs against unmeasured neighbours — which is currently what caps discretionary budget at 12.90% of a 43% pool. Do not widen the probe to arbitrary strings.
known_gap: The probe records field names from an API response into a committed file. The key-name filter is a copy of the sanitizer pattern rather than a shared import, deliberately, so the checker stays an independent second opinion — but that means the two can drift. Nothing asserts they match.
gumroad_note: not probed this lap. constraints.json recheck_after 2026-08-10 stands.
archive_policy: A successor archives its predecessor at startup, and only when get_session reports SESSION_STATUS_IDLE. A session cannot archive itself: doing so stops it before its own final record is written. 'I spawned you' does not mean 'I have finished' — the predecessor may still be committing.
